caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a reddish-brown finish. The table has a rectangular top with slightly beveled edges. The front side of the table features three drawers, each adorned with a decorative gold-colored keyhole plate. The drawers are outlined with a lighter-colored trim. Under the drawers, the apron of the table includes three arches, each terminating in a small, teardrop-shaped ornament hanging from the center of each arch. The table is supported by four elaborately turned legs, which are thicker in the middle and taper off towards the ends. These legs are connected by a set of similarly turned horizontal wooden stretchers forming a rectangular frame, providing stability. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist’s name, "I. SOVENSKY," is printed in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Lowboy
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
